title: Non-anchor 4-by-25 segmented grid row-edge prediction
rationale: This lane predeclares a 4-by-25 padded row-edge target before any future source-backed observation is scored. The registered Sanborn-papers archive is archive-context-only, so it can justify a bounded segmented-cipher structural rule but cannot supply scored positions. This is not another public-anchor mining pass because discovery uses only K4 ciphertext length, the fixed public-anchor exclusion mask, and the source-context 4-by-4 segmented-cipher/overlay rationale; it does not use candidate material, route results, additive fragment values, prior row-boundary evidence, or public-fragment match counts.
prediction_target: Future independently sourced non-anchor K4 position observations should be enriched at predeclared row-edge positions in a 4-by-25 row-major padded grid if a segmented overlay or null-mask structure is relevant.
discovery_inputs: Known-clue occupied positions for exclusion only
Registered archive-context source kryptosbot-sanborn-papers-2026 for bounded overlay, segmented-cipher, and multi-element puzzle context
Predeclared 4-by-25 row-major padded grid and row-edge rule emitted before observing or scoring future source-backed positions
evaluation_inputs: Future source-documented non-anchor K4 position observations
Observation files that declare eligible source IDs, one-based positions, per-position notes, and rationale before evaluation
Source-backed position sets not used to construct or tune the 4-by-25 grid-layout artifact
controls: seeded null over sampled non-anchor position sets of the same size
validate-grid-observations and evaluate-grid-prediction required before interpreting source-backed observations
the evaluator must use --edge-axis row with this preregistration before a source-backed archive can be treated as evidence
validate-prediction-artifact --require-unique-artifact must pass before treating this as a distinct prediction target
multiple-comparison correction if interpreted beside period, spacing, mirror, 7-by-14 grid, 14-by-7 grid, Tableau/HILL, or ciphertext-prior families
archive-context-only sources cannot directly provide scored observation positions
